definitions.gloss: being roused to action; getting motivated; being inspired
definitions.explanation: having one's spirit stirred up and becoming determined to act

notes:
{発奮|はっぷん} means to be roused or inspired to action, often triggered by encouragement or adversity.

WRITING:
- ⟦{発|はつ}→〜発：04026_hatsu⟧ (emit, start)
- {奮|ふん} (rouse, stir up)

USAGE:
- {発奮|はっぷん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be roused to action - suru verb)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{発奮|はっぷん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be inspired by ~)
- {発奮|はっぷん}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧ (to motivate someone)

COMMON TRIGGERS:
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{発奮|はっぷん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (inspired by words)
- {悔|くや}しさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{発奮|はっぷん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (motivated by frustration)
- ⟦{激励|げきれい}→激励：15022_gekirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{発奮|はっぷん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (roused by encouragement)

ALTERNATIVE WRITING:
- Also written as {発憤|はっぷん}
- {発憤|はっぷん} emphasizes the emotional aspect more

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{奮起|ふんき}→奮起：07970_funki⟧ (rousing oneself)
- ⟦{奮闘|ふんとう}→奮闘：07901_funtou⟧ (hard struggle)
- ⟦やる{気|き}→やる気：05089_yaruki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to get motivated - casual)
- ⟦{鼓舞|こぶ}→鼓舞：14713_kobu⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be encouraged)
